auth.description: Agent API key (prefix: rl_admin_*, rl_agent_*, rl_member_*)

tools.name: check_health
tools.description:
Check API health and key identity
Returns the authenticated key's identity, role, scopes, rate limit, and owner information. Use this as a connectivity and configuration check before calling business endpoints.

tools.name: list_loyalty_cards
tools.description:
List all loyalty cards for this partner
Returns paginated loyalty cards owned by the authenticated partner. Supports pagination via page and per_page query parameters.

tools.name: create_loyalty_card
tools.description:
Create a new loyalty card
Creates a loyalty card with the specified points economy configuration. Requires the club_id of an existing club owned by this partner.

tools.name: get_loyalty_card
tools.description:
Get a specific loyalty card
Returns a single loyalty card by ID. The card must belong to the authenticated partner.

tools.name: update_loyalty_card
tools.description:
Update an existing loyalty card
Updates a loyalty card owned by the authenticated partner. Only provided fields are updated.

tools.name: delete_loyalty_card
tools.description:
Delete a loyalty card
Permanently deletes a loyalty card owned by the authenticated partner.

tools.name: list_clubs
tools.description:
List all clubs for this partner
Returns paginated clubs owned by the authenticated partner.

tools.name: create_club
tools.description:
Create a new club
Creates a club owned by the authenticated partner.

tools.name: get_club
tools.description:
Get a specific club
Returns a single club by ID. The club must belong to the authenticated partner.

tools.name: update_club
tools.description:
Update an existing club
Updates a club owned by the authenticated partner. Only provided fields are updated.

tools.name: delete_club
tools.description:
Delete a club
Deletes a club owned by the authenticated partner. Protected clubs cannot be deleted.

tools.name: list_members
tools.description:
List members who interacted with this partner
Returns paginated members that have transactions with this partner's cards. Searchable by name, email, member number, or unique identifier.

search.description: Search by name, email, member number, or unique identifier

tools.name: get_member
tools.description:
Get a specific member
Returns member details. Accepts UUID as path parameter. Member must have interacted with this partner's cards.

tools.name: get_member_balance
tools.description:
Get a member's balance on a specific card
Returns the member's point balance for a specific loyalty card. Both the member and card must belong to this partner.

tools.name: list_rewards
tools.description:
List all rewards for this partner
Returns paginated rewards owned by the authenticated partner. Requires loyalty cards feature to be enabled.

tools.name: create_reward
tools.description:
Create a new reward
Creates a reward that members can claim by spending loyalty points.

points.description: Points required to claim this reward

tools.name: get_reward
tools.description:
Get a specific reward
Returns a single reward by ID. The reward must belong to the authenticated partner.

tools.name: update_reward
tools.description:
Update an existing reward
Updates a reward owned by the authenticated partner. Only provided fields are updated.

tools.name: delete_reward
tools.description:
Delete a reward
Permanently deletes a reward owned by the authenticated partner.

tools.name: list_staff
tools.description:
List all staff members for this partner
Returns paginated staff members owned by the authenticated partner.

tools.name: create_staff_member
tools.description:
Create a new staff member
Creates a staff member who can perform loyalty operations.

tools.name: get_staff_member
tools.description:
Get a specific staff member
Returns a single staff member by ID.

tools.name: update_staff_member
tools.description:
Update an existing staff member
Updates a staff member owned by the authenticated partner.

tools.name: delete_staff_member
tools.description:
Delete a staff member
Permanently deletes a staff member owned by the authenticated partner.

tools.name: list_stamp_cards
tools.description:
List all stamp cards for this partner
Returns paginated stamp cards owned by the authenticated partner.

tools.name: create_stamp_card
tools.description:
Create a new stamp card
Creates a stamp card with the specified configuration. Requires stamp cards feature to be enabled.

tools.name: get_stamp_card
tools.description:
Get a specific stamp card
Returns a single stamp card by ID.

tools.name: update_stamp_card
tools.description:
Update an existing stamp card
Updates a stamp card owned by the authenticated partner. Only provided fields are updated.

tools.name: delete_stamp_card
tools.description:
Delete a stamp card
Permanently deletes a stamp card owned by the authenticated partner.

tools.name: add_stamps
tools.description:
Add stamps to a member's stamp card
Awards stamp(s) to a member on the specified stamp card. If the card is completed, a pending reward is created.

member_identifier.description: UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier

tools.name: redeem_stamp_reward
tools.description:
Redeem a pending stamp reward
Redeems one pending reward for a member on the specified stamp card. The member must have a completed card with an unclaimed reward.

member_identifier.description: UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier

tools.name: list_tiers
tools.description:
List all tiers for this partner
Returns paginated tiers owned by the authenticated partner, ordered by level.

tools.name: create_tier
tools.description:
Create a new tier
Creates a loyalty tier within a club.

tools.name: get_tier
tools.description:
Get a specific tier
Returns a single tier by ID.

tools.name: update_tier
tools.description:
Update an existing tier
Updates a tier owned by the authenticated partner.

tools.name: delete_tier
tools.description:
Delete a tier
Permanently deletes a tier owned by the authenticated partner.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description:
List transactions for this partner
Returns paginated transactions with optional filters by member, card, event type, and date range.

member_identifier.description: Filter by member (UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier)

tools.name: record_purchase
tools.description:
Record a purchase and award loyalty points
Records a purchase transaction. Points awarded are calculated from the card's points_per_currency ratio, or can be set explicitly via the points parameter. The member_identifier accepts UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier.

member_identifier.description: UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier

tools.name: redeem_reward
tools.description:
Redeem a reward and deduct loyalty points
Claims a reward for a member, deducting the required points from their balance. The reward must be linked to the specified card.

member_identifier.description: UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier

tools.name: list_vouchers
tools.description:
List all vouchers for this partner
Returns paginated vouchers owned by the authenticated partner.

tools.name: create_voucher
tools.description:
Create a new voucher
Creates a voucher with the specified type and value. If no code is provided, one is generated automatically.

tools.name: get_voucher
tools.description:
Get a specific voucher
Returns a single voucher by ID.

tools.name: update_voucher
tools.description:
Update an existing voucher
Updates a voucher owned by the authenticated partner. Only provided fields are updated.

tools.name: delete_voucher
tools.description:
Delete a voucher
Soft-deletes a voucher owned by the authenticated partner.

tools.name: validate_voucher
tools.description:
Validate a voucher code without redeeming
Checks if a voucher code is valid for a member and optionally calculates the discount for a given order amount.

member_identifier.description: UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier

order_amount.description: Order amount in cents for discount calculation

tools.name: redeem_voucher
tools.description:
Redeem a voucher for a member
Redeems a voucher for a member, applying the discount/bonus and recording the usage. Uses transactional locking to prevent race conditions.

member_identifier.description: UUID, email, member number, or unique identifier
